notes.title: Episode 4-5 Release Date
notes.notes:
[i]"And so I wept."

"The unending truth was too much to bear."

"Now I lie in a void of silence."[/i]

Yup, it's almost here. It's been two years since I originally started working on The Doll Beneath, and now it's finally time to bring it to a close. I've thought long and hard on how I want it to end, especially with how much time and effort I put into the characters. Now that a good amount of time has passed, I think I can safely end it without much worry about what people might think.

To be fair, this is technically my first game I've officially released to the public. Sure I've made other "projects" in the past, but none of which can really compare to this.

[u][b]EPISODE 4[/b][/u]

[i]Play as Kiyoko as you attempt to piece together the loose ends left behind by a long and forgotten cult. New faces, old friends, they're all the same. In the end, Akio is all you will ever need. "He" is all you will ever need. Listen to your heart, not your mind. The [b]face[/b] isn't there to harm you.[/i]

[u][b]EPISODE 5[/b][/u]

[i]Play as [???] as you enter into the minds of [???], in an attempt to save them. With the knowledge you've gathered, do you have what it takes to finally end this?
[/i]

Besides all that, I also have one other surprise planned for the final release. Have you ever wondered what was behind the door in the gallery? Well you will soon.

The final release will drop on [b]May 3rd[/b]. Trust me, it'll definitely be worth your [u]time[/u].

I also have another announcement that will soon follow regarding my next project, which isn't exactly "safe for work," but still a game nonetheless.

Anyway, that's it for now. See ya!

...
...
...

Oh, and has anyone found the easter egg in Episode 2, Chapter 3 yet? I've searched high and low, and I don't think anyone has found it. Ahh, oh well.

notes.title: Episode 3 Release Date
notes.notes:
Yup! It's almost here, and just in time for the new year! Episode 3 is now getting an official release date!

The Losinglight subjects finally arrive at the doorstep of the Kemden Tower, formerly owned by a mysterious robotics company. Follow Yuko Sakuma, as she slowly unravels EGO's secrets, as well as her own. 

Just remember, you're not alone in there.

One of the Doll Beneath's main piece of criticism from the previous episodes was the fact that the story is extremely slow, and rarely has moments of intensity. Taking that feedback, I've went out of my way to make Episode 3 a lot more fast-paced and unique. We're at the half-way point, we might as well amp things up.

I can't wait to finally get this out, as it will be one of the most lore heavy chapters to be released yet. Episode 3 will be released on [b]November 30th, 2022[/b].

Now...

notes.title: The Doll Beneath Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42011365/b2b111b0569460da404b44cb273d98d738300adc.png[/img]

With the release of The Doll Beneath right around the corner, I am very excited to finally get this thing out to the public. The Doll Beneath is will ultimately be a fun experience, and I am very curious to see what people think of it. 

Also, keep in-mind, if everything goes to plan, The Doll Beneath might even release [b]EARLIER[/b] than the intended release date. How's that for an announcement?

The Doll Beneath will release with two out of five planned episodes. Stay tuned for any future updates!
